detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a medium shot square photograph up the upper flight: heavy brown boots and dark brown trouser legs stand on the treads in the RIGHT half of frame with their heels toward the camera, his broad reddened bare RIGHT hand closed on the mahogany banister at the RIGHT edge, the panelled sitting-room door across the TOP of frame at two fifths of its width, cold grey late-morning daylight on the brown carpet. The camera is Hip height above the second tread of the upper flight, five treads back from the boots, a 35mm lens turned square up the flight at the sitting-room door. The mahogany banister and its turned balusters keep the RIGHT edge. The camera rises one tread with it and the sitting-room door widens a hand's breadth at the top of frame as the leading boot lifts and sets down one whole tread higher, from 00:00 to 00:04.
[Shot 2] From 00:04 to 00:09. At 00:04 the shot cuts to an insert square photograph on the mahogany rail near the head of the upper flight, beginning from <Picture 3>: a broad reddened hand, the dark brown sack-coat cuff at its wrist, closed round the rail, a large blue paper envelope as wide as that spread hand flat against the mahogany under the thumb, the turned balusters below it, the panelled sitting-room door filling the TOP of frame edge to edge in cold grey daylight; only what <Picture 3> shows is in frame. The camera is Rail height on the middle of the third tread below the head of the flight, a forearm's length out from the mahogany. At the first frame The broad reddened bare hand is closed round the mahogany rail at the CENTRE of frame. The camera rises one tread with it and the panelled door widens to the frame's full width as the broad hand slides two balusters' width up the mahogany rail toward the door, from 00:04 to 00:09.
